overview_description.description:
GFACE operates as an online gaming platform that offers a range of online games as well as other services.

The platform’s services include creating a profile page; participating in blogs and forums; uploading media such as photographs, text, and videos; purchasing virtual items; and many other services.

GFACE was launched by [Crytek](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/crytek), an interactive entertainment development company.
